verbatim_text: Article 9 of the KVKK states that the Authority is empowered to take adequate measures in the processing of special categories of personal data.
source_document: KB 2/Turkey/Kişisel Verilerin Korunması Kanunu (Turkish Personal Data Protection Law - KVKK).pdf

verbatim_text: the Authority has outlined a set of measures, such as non-disclosure agreements, determination of access rights, cryptographic retention, and process logs, which can be employed during the processing of personal data
source_document: KB 2/Turkey/Kişisel Verilerin Korunması Kanunu (Turkish Personal Data Protection Law - KVKK).pdf

verbatim_text: Article 9(4) of the GDPR permits member states to retain or introduce additional conditions, including limitations, related to the processing of genetic data, biometric data, or data concerning health
